U, Γ, ΞSet of UAVs, TBSs and satellites connected to UAVs, respectively
ΨSet of users served by UAVs
SuSet of satellites sharing the same frequency with the u-th UAV
OuSet of users served by satellites and interfered by the u-th UAV
RU,ψu,tErgodic achievable rate between the u-th UAV and its user in Ψ at time t
RΓ,Uγ,u,tErgodic achievable rate between the γ-th TBS and the u-th UAV at time t

RSu,OuS,o,tErgodic achievable rate between the s-th satellite in Su and the o-th user in Ou at time t
